verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the official MP CLI, which lets a user operate 'reports' (alongside payments, preferences, and subscriptions) with a single token and no browser. That is a glancing indication that the product itself provides programmatic access to account and transaction data. Nothing documents a complete data export, open file formats, or an account-exit path. Missing for 10: documented full-account data export, explicit open formats (e.g., CSV/JSON), coverage of all data types, account closure/portability guidance, independent corroboration.
